vendor.blurb: K3 is the largest open model at 2.8T params; agents and frontend coding lead

highlights: LMArena Text 1488, #16, highest among open models
WebDev 1660, #9; took #1 on Frontend Code Arena at launch
Agent Swarm orchestrates up to 300 sub-agents
kimi-k3.notes: Thinking is always on by default; low/max effort tiers are merged. The new K3 License takes up to a 30% revenue share from providers earning over $20M a year. Anthropic accused it of distilling Claude; CheatBench cheat rate 72.3%.

bench.AA Intelligence Index: Max tier; #3 overall at launch, low tier 34
bench.Vals AI Index: Launch-day ranking; exact score not found

kimi-k3-1.tagline: Teased by Moonshot, delayed again and again
highlights: Moonshot dropped official hints; it's on the "confirmed coming soon" list
Leaker ChrisGPT says it won't ship this week or next, another delay
kimi-k3-1.notes: Unreleased as of 9/29; parameters, pricing and scores unknown, tier/score held at K3's values as a placeholder. A Kimi K4 also showed up in the leaked OpenCode sitemap.

kimi-k2-6.tagline: The last open-weights king, Agent Swarm matured
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 54 at launch, #1 open, ahead of DeepSeek V4 Pro
kimi-k2-6.notes: Thinking and non-thinking modes merged into one entry; Modified MIT license. The Kimi Work desktop app runs K2.6 by default.

kimi-k2-7-code.tagline: A coding-specialized spin on the K2 base
highlights: Kimi Code Bench v2 up 21.8% over K2.6
About 30% fewer reasoning tokens on the same tasks
Highspeed variant outputs ~180 tok/s, 260 on short context
kimi-k2-7-code.notes: Moonshot only published gains over K2.6 on its own benchmark, with no SWE-bench-style public scores; a kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed variant also exists.

kimi-k2-5.tagline: Where Kimi's multimodality and swarms began
highlights: First to add MoonViT, a 400M-parameter vision encoder
Debuted Agent Swarm, orchestrating up to 100 sub-agents
kimi-k2-5.notes: API retired 2026-08-31; circulates only as open weights. Instant and thinking modes merged.
kimi-k2-5.pricing: $0.60 / $3 per 1M tokens (final official price before retirement)
